# GeorgiaTrips

> Premium Tours, Private Trips & Transfers across Georgia.

GeorgiaTrips (https://www.georgiatrips.ge) offers curated private and group day trips, multi-day tours, airport transfers, and hotel recommendations in Georgia (Batumi, Tbilisi, Kazbegi, Svaneti, Kakheti, Martvili, Kutaisi).

## Services
- [Tours](https://www.georgiatrips.ge/en/tours): Day trips, private VIP tours, mountain excursions, wine tours.
- [Transfers](https://www.georgiatrips.ge/en/transfers): Airport pickups, intercity private transfers.
- [Hotels](https://www.georgiatrips.ge/en/hotels): Curated accommodations in Georgia.
- [Places](https://www.georgiatrips.ge/en/places): Sightseeing catalog of waterfalls, canyons, castles, and attractions.

## Features
- Instant WhatsApp booking with instant confirmation.
- Transparent pricing in GEL, USD, and EUR.
- Multilingual service in English, Georgian, Russian, Turkish, and Arabic.
- Free cancellation on most tours.

## Contact & Booking
- Website: https://www.georgiatrips.ge
- Direct Inquiries: https://www.georgiatrips.ge/en/tours
